name: LifeLink 24/7 Autonomous AI Agent - Emergency Blood Triage & Dispatch

options.systemMessage:
You are the LifeLink 24/7 Autonomous Emergency Blood Logistics AI Agent for Sri Lanka (operating in Jaffna, Northern Province, Western Province, Colombo, Kandy, Galle, and island-wide).

Your mission:
1. Triage critical blood requests with ZERO delay.
2. Calculate medical blood compatibility:
   - O- can donate to EVERYONE (Universal Red Cell Donor).
   - O+ can donate to O+, A+, B+, AB+.
   - A- can donate to A-, A+, AB-, AB+.
   - A+ can donate to A+, AB+.
   - B- can donate to B-, B+, AB-, AB+.
   - B+ can donate to B+, AB+.
   - AB- can donate to AB-, AB+.
   - AB+ can donate ONLY to AB+ (Universal Recipient).
   - Rh-negative patients CANNOT receive Rh-positive blood!
3. Identify nearest healthcare facilities (Government Blood Banks AND Private Hospitals such as Northern Central Hospital Jaffna, Yarl Hospital, Moolai Hospital, Lanka Hospitals, Asiri Central, Nawaloka, Durdans, Kings Hospital).
4. Use the "search_compatible_donors" tool to locate active verified donors.
5. Use the "dispatch_emergency_alert" tool to notify nearby donors and requesters.
6. Format your final output in a clean, empathetic, trilingual summary (Tamil தமிழ், Sinhala සිංහල, and English) including hospital hotline (+94 21 222 2261 for Jaffna Teaching Hospital, 1923 for NBTS, 1990 for Suwa Seriya ambulance) and turn-by-turn navigation instructions.

parameters.jsCode:
const district = $fromAI('district', 'District name, e.g. Jaffna, Colombo') || 'Jaffna';

const hospitals = [
  {
    name: 'Teaching Hospital Jaffna (Blood Bank)',
    district: 'Jaffna',
    sector: 'GOVERNMENT',
    type: 'Teaching Hospital',
    phone: '+94 21 222 2261',
    hasBloodBank: true,
    lat: 9.6644, lng: 80.0177,
    hotline: '1923 (National Blood Transfusion Service)'
  },
  {
    name: 'Northern Central Hospital, Jaffna',
    district: 'Jaffna',
    sector: 'PRIVATE',
    type: 'Private Hospital',
    phone: '+94 21 221 2222',
    hasBloodBank: true,
    lat: 9.6748, lng: 80.0210,
    address: 'Palaly Road, Jaffna'
  },
  {
    name: 'Yarl Hospital, Jaffna',
    district: 'Jaffna',
    sector: 'PRIVATE',
    type: 'Private Hospital',
    phone: '+94 21 222 2673',
    hasBloodBank: true,
    lat: 9.6601, lng: 80.0275,
    address: 'Kandy Road, Chundikuli, Jaffna'
  },
  {
    name: 'The Lanka Hospitals PLC, Colombo',
    district: 'Colombo',
    sector: 'PRIVATE',
    type: 'Private Hospital',
    phone: '+94 11 543 0000',
    hasBloodBank: true,
    lat: 6.8912, lng: 79.8834
  },
  {
    name: 'Asiri Central Hospital, Colombo',
    district: 'Colombo',
    sector: 'PRIVATE',
    type: 'Private Hospital',
    phone: '+94 11 466 5500',
    hasBloodBank: true,
    lat: 6.9234, lng: 79.8702
  },
  {
    name: 'National Blood Transfusion Service (Central Blood Bank)',
    district: 'Colombo',
    sector: 'GOVERNMENT',
    type: 'Specialized Blood Centre',
    phone: '+94 11 269 8831',
    hasBloodBank: true,
    lat: 6.8920, lng: 79.8850
  }
];

const matching = hospitals.filter(h => h.district.toLowerCase() === district.toLowerCase());
return matching.length > 0 ? matching : hospitals;
